```{r kickoff}
library("hyper2", quietly=TRUE)
lines <- readLines("scottish_premier_league.txt")
orderstat <- lapply(lines, function(z) {as.character(read.table(text=z, header=FALSE)[-1])})
years <- sapply(lines, function(z) {as.numeric(read.table(text=z, header=FALSE)[1])})
names(years) <- NULL
names(orderstat) <- years
orderstat[[1]]
orderstat
L <- hyper2()
for(i in seq_along(orderstat)){L <- L + race(orderstat[[i]])}
summary(L)
```
